pairs.en: To this end, we propose two adaptive modules for enhancing Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) with new capabilities: 1) a Node Adaptive Parameter Learning (NAPL) module to capture node-speciﬁc patterns; 2) a Data Adaptive Graph Generation (DAGG) module to infer the inter-dependencies among different trafﬁc series automatically.
pairs.zh: 为此，我们提出了两个自适应模块来增强图卷积网络（GCN）的新功能： 1）节点自适应参数学习（NAPL）模块来捕获节点特定模式；2）数据自适应图生成（DAGG）模块自动推断不同交通序列之间的相互依赖关系。

pairs.en: Recent works focus on designing complicated graph neural network architectures to capture shared patterns with the help of pre-deﬁned graphs. In this paper, we argue that learning node-speciﬁc patterns is essential for trafﬁc forecasting while the pre-deﬁned graph is avoidable.
pairs.zh: 最近的工作集中在设计复杂的图神经网络架构以借助预定义图捕获共享模式。在本文中，我们认为学习节点特定模式对于交通预测至关重要，而预定义图是可以避免的。

pairs.en: Modeling complex spatial and temporal correlations in the correlated time series data is indispensable for understanding the trafﬁc dynamics and predicting the future status of an evolving trafﬁc system.
pairs.zh: 对相关时间序列数据中复杂的空间和时间相关性进行建模对于理解交通动态和预测不断发展的交通系统的未来状态是必不可少的。
